literal: Otherwise, why am I alive indeed? With him, I, the spent days, remembering, am alive.
translation: Otherwise, how indeed do I survive? I only remain alive by remembering the days I spent with him.
modern: அப்படியில்லையென்றால் நான் எவ்வாறு உயிரோடு இருப்பேன்? அவரோடு நான் கூடி வாழ்ந்த நாட்களை நினைத்துப் பார்ப்பதால் மட்டுமே நான் உயிரோடு இருக்கிறேன்.
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the pain of separation, explains how she manages to stay alive. She asks how she could possibly survive otherwise, revealing that her existence depends entirely on memory. It is only by constantly remembering (உள்ள) the happy days (நாள்) she spent (உற்ற) in union with her lover (அவரொடு) that she keeps her breath. Without these sweet recollections to sustain her, she would have perished from grief.
